name: The Ritz-Carlton, Marina del Rey
positioning: Waterfront Ritz-Carlton on the Marina del Rey marina, with a heated saltwater pool, a Sisley Spa and tennis and pickleball courts on site
best_for: Travelers who want a marina-side base in Los Angeles with a heated saltwater pool and Sisley Spa
Active guests who want on-site tennis and pickleball and bicycle rentals for the coast

facts.text: Cast & Plow is the hotel's marina-front restaurant serving fresh, locally sourced cuisine.
Wave Bar + Grill is a seasonal restaurant serving coastal cuisine with marina views.
Sisley Spa treatments use Sisley products infused with essential oils and extracts.
Rooms and suites have Juliet balconies overlooking the marina and a coastal-chic decor.
The Abbot Kinney neighborhood in Venice, with boutiques, restaurants and coffee shops, is one mile from the hotel.
The hotel can arrange a private yacht excursion or dinner cruise on the marina.
The Ritz-Carlton Club experience is being reimagined and will debut in July 2027.

highlights.text: The spa has direct pool access and a couple's suite.
From June through October the hotel has a Butterfly Beach House where guests can see the lifecycle of native butterflies.
The hotel has waterfront lighted tennis courts and lighted pickleball courts on site.
The hotel has a heated saltwater pool.
The hotel offers bicycle rentals for riding to nearby Santa Monica, Venice and Manhattan Beaches.

considerations.text: The hotel does not have an airport shuttle to Los Angeles International Airport.
Club access requires an upgraded booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to the Club.
Breakfast at Cast & Plow is available for a fee.
